rule_or_requirement: Finish-line completion comes before lap time; pixels are the only permitted inference observations.
observable_information: Current 84x84 grayscale road rows, near asphalt width, far road direction, bright obstacle cue, and actions from fixed historical pixel policies.
allowed_action_or_state_change: On fully visible unobstructed road where fast pedal is already selected, shift steering modestly toward the inside of the visible bend; keep the existing pedal and obstacle controls.
expected_success_endpoint: Visible inner-bend steering activation and no lost finish on the consumed activation cell, followed by no lower completion rate and shorter median finished lap on a separately registered fresh three-track tune.
control: Exact-hash selected full-road-guard actor and exact-hash fast-pedal-stable-steer actor on identical 1/184 official environment cell.
falsifier: No apex steering activation, invalid action, earlier retirement, or loss of finish on the consumed activation cell; later, lower matched fresh-tune finish rate than the selected control.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Three registered pixel-runtime profiles on consumed tune track 1 seed 184, 2000 decisions per profile, including full per-decision action trace.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux/Python 3.11 CPU, 1800-second registered diagnostic limit; exact checkpoint hashes; no new tune or held-out use in this first step; no website action.
